queries.description: Ensure that HEALTHCHECK is being used. The HEALTHCHECK instruction tells Docker how to test a container to check that it is still working
Check if any apt-get installs don't use '--no-install-recommends' flag to avoid installing additional packages.

files.search_key: FROM={{ubuntu:18.04}}.{{RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y     python3     python3-pip     curl     vim     dnsutils}}
files.expected_value: 'RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y     python3     python3-pip     curl     vim     dnsutils' uses '--no-install-recommends' flag to avoid installing additional packages
files.actual_value: 'RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y     python3     python3-pip     curl     vim     dnsutils' does not use '--no-install-recommends' flag to avoid installing additional packages
